dhcp_server.dnsmasq_customizations:
# nest-mitm: route every Nest camera's default gateway at the test interceptor.
# One dhcp-host line per MAC on purpose: a second line for the same MAC silently
# drops the reservation (verified). Every line carries set:cam, so the single
# dhcp-option below applies to all of them. 1h leases: a camera flips onto the
# interceptor within ~30 minutes of a change, and back just as fast on rollback.
dhcp-host=b8:7b:d4:da:5e:17,nest-cam-indoor.lan,192.168.86.192,1h,set:cam
dhcp-host=b8:7b:d4:e8:b2:bf,cam-79.lan,192.168.86.79,1h,set:cam
dhcp-host=cc:a7:c1:60:0e:df,cam-164.lan,192.168.86.164,1h,set:cam
dhcp-host=3c:31:74:bf:75:b2,cam-191.lan,192.168.86.191,1h,set:cam
dhcp-host=3c:31:74:55:a4:2c,cam-210.lan,192.168.86.210,1h,set:cam
dhcp-host=cc:a7:c1:68:f0:03,cam-233.lan,192.168.86.233,1h,set:cam
dhcp-option=cam,3,192.168.86.56

# switch2 (4c:30:6a:de:9f:01 at .28): tag -> router override. Reservation and
# dhcp-option must name the same MAC; this is the console, not the Switch 1.
dhcp-host=4c:30:6a:de:9f:01,switch2.lan,192.168.86.28,1h,set:sw2
dhcp-option=sw2,3,192.168.86.56
dhcp-option=sw2,6,192.168.86.56

# shark-re MITM (card t_fa9e2197): hand the robot a resolver we own.
# Scoped by MAC tag: only this host's DHCPACK carries option 6 -> 192.168.86.19.
# Nothing else in this string is modified; revert removes exactly these lines.
dhcp-host=40:f4:c9:3e:10:c9,192.168.86.26,1h,set:sharkrobot
dhcp-option=sharkrobot,6,192.168.86.19
# end shark-re MITM block
# lab phone (OnePlus Open, .126): default gateway -> .41 so its HTTPS lands on the
# source-scoped full-capture listener there (port 8445). The reservation lives HERE
# rather than in dhcp_client_settings because a second dhcp-host line for the same
# MAC silently drops the reservation (see the note at the top of this block).
# Revert = delete these three lines, re-add the phone in the DHCP client list.
dhcp-host=a2:cf:35:30:52:ab,oneplus-open.lan,192.168.86.126,24h,set:opphone
dhcp-option=opphone,3,192.168.86.41
# end lab phone capture block
